name: codex-safe-setup
description: Audit and install a least-privilege, recoverable local Codex configuration.

author.name: QianQIUlp and Codex Safe Setup Contributors

interface.longDescription: Audits filesystem, credential-read, network, approval, and recovery boundaries; then installs a consent-driven least-privilege profile with rollback, Git checkpoints, and opt-in linked-worktree commits.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Codex permissions and install the recommended safe profile.
Explain what my current Codex setup can read, change, and send.
Verify my Codex safety configuration and checkpoint recovery.
